column1: # 第三版句子块「- **结构**：」能用的标签。build.py check 读这份文件（标签只能用第一列的字样），难句本按这里的行序分组。
# 每行：标签<TAB>定义<TAB>读法<TAB>例句（出处）。# 开头的行是注释；第一行不是注释的是表头。例句出自 demo 的原文。词汇只给卡句用，单独用，不进难句本的分组。

column2: 主语和谓语之间插了长修饰，谓语来得晚
column3: 先跳过逗号之间的部分，找到谓语再回头
column4: The old grey horse, dreaming, as he plodded along, of his quiet paddock, …, simply abandoned himself to his natural emotions.（第 2 章）

column2: it 先占住主语或宾语的位置，真的在后面（形式主语、形式宾语）
column3: 看到 it is hard、it seems、find it，往后找 that 或 to
column4: it soon seemed taken for granted by all three of them that the trip was a settled thing（第 2 章）

column2: 名词后面跟一串修饰，一层套一层
column3: 从中心词往后一层层剥，每层只管它前面那个名词
column4: the steep little tunnel which answered in his case to the gravelled carriage-drive owned by animals whose residences are nearer to the sun and air（第 1 章）

column3: 一个引导词开一层，先把最外面一层读完
column4: see if they know anything about that motorcar and who it belongs to（第 2 章）

column2: doing、done、to do 短语作状语或补语
column3: 找它的动作是谁发出的，通常是主句的主语
column4: Rearing, plunging, backing steadily, …, he drove the cart backward towards the deep ditch（第 2 章）

column2: 分词自己带主语，不借主句的
column3: 名词加分词，当成一个小句子读
column4: a slow train having landed them at a station not very far from Toad Hall, they escorted …（第 2 章）

column2: 逗号、破折号、括号之间插进来的话
column3: 先拿掉再读，读通了再放回去
column4: the Rat, though still unconvinced in his mind, allowed his good-nature to override his personal objections（第 2 章）

column2: 几个谓语或几个分句并排
column3: 找 and、or、but 和逗号，看清谁和谁并排
column4: they escorted … Toad to his door, put him inside it, and instructed his housekeeper to feed him, undress him, and put him to bed（第 2 章）

column2: 省掉了能补出来的词（be、重复的动词），补出来才通
column4: Panels and windows smashed, axles hopelessly bent, one wheel off（第 2 章，省了 were）

column2: 谓语或助动词跑到主语前面
column4: How black was his despair when he felt himself sinking again!（第 1 章）

column2: 两个词隔着一段话相互呼应：so … that、not so much … as，强调句 it was … that
column3: 看到前一半，往后找后一半
column4: it was not till the afternoon that they came out on the high road（第 2 章）

column2: 代词指什么要回前文找
column3: 往前找最近的、数和意思都对得上的名词
column4: He has got a new craze, and it always takes him that way, in its first stage.（第 2 章）

column2: 结构不难，读者卡在词上（只用在卡句上，单独用，不进难句本）
column3: 先看注里的词，再顺着读一遍
column4: The Mole was bewitched, entranced, fascinated.（第 1 章）
